visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young male creator with short black hair, wearing a navy blue polo shirt with white collar trim and grey trousers, stands in an empty, brightly lit white room. He speaks directly to the camera with energetic hand gestures, smiles, and gives two thumbs up, framed in a medium shot. (2) The scene cuts to a transition showing several staff members in black uniforms with white logos on the back labeled 'YAO JIAN'. They are crouched down, using a specialized tool to tap on grey floor tiles and inspecting the frame of a sliding glass door. (3) Detailed inspection shots follow: a staff member uses green adhesive tape to mark defects on a white wall, another checks the plumbing under a stainless steel kitchen sink, and an endoscope camera is inserted into a floor drain on a grey-tiled balcony. (4) The camera pans across the balcony where a hose is spraying water onto the tiles to test the drainage slope, while a technician points to areas with a flashlight. Close-up shots of a smartphone screen display photos of technical flaws like gaps in pipe insulation. (5) The creator returns to the eye-level shot, standing in the living area, holding a thick white inspection report. He gestures with his hands to emphasize points while speaking enthusiastically. (6) The video concludes with a group shot of the creator and four technicians posing together in the apartment, with a vibrant yellow graphic overlay appearing at the bottom of the frame.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio opens with a high-arousal male narrator speaking over an upbeat, 124 BPM electronic background track with clear synthesizer melodies and a driving 4/4 drum beat. The vocal is energetic and friendly, with a fast speech rate and clear articulation. (2) A sharp percussive 'click' or 'impact' sound effect marks a transition to the inspection scene, accompanied by soft footsteps and the metallic scraping of tools against floor tiles. The BGM remains steady in intensity as the vocal delivery continues with high valence. (3) The sound of rushing water and liquid splashing (balcony flood test) becomes prominent, layered with the professional narrative tone of a second speaker. Short, high-pitched digital UI 'pings' are used as sound effects to highlight specific visual defects. (4) A metallic tapping sound (tile inspection stick) repeats rhythmically, while the BGM continues to provide a consistent energy floor. The ambient noise reflects a slight room reverb typical of an empty indoor space. (5) A final high-pitched digital chime and 'whoosh' transition sound occurs as the narrator returns to a high-volume closing statement, with the music maintaining its bright spectral centroid and energetic pace until a hard cut at the end.

It combines lifestyle vlogging with a detailed product/service demonstration to build trust and encourage viewers to use the service for their own home inspections.
